name: open-leprechaun
description: A self-hosted ledger that produces German tax figures

scripts.setup:api: python3.14 -m venv apps/api/.venv && apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --quiet --upgrade pip && apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --quiet -r apps/api/requirements.txt -r apps/api/requirements-dev.txt && apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --quiet --no-deps -e apps/api
scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm db:up && apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.lint: apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check apps/api && apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.format: apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix apps/api && apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format apps/api
